why: Per rooftop per month is how dealers already buy website and inventory tools, and it matches the pilot agreement. $149 sits well under the auto-posting tools most dealers compare against, and about where a store stops asking the general manager. Five salespeople covers a typical used-car desk; the seat price keeps a 12-person store from being free. The founding rate is for the first design-partner stores that put up with the rough edges.
wouldChangeIt: Pilot feedback that the used car manager values the sold-car flag more than posting speed: price the manager view, not the posting.
A store posting far more than 10 cars per salesperson per day: a usage tier.
Attorney advice on Meta exposure that changes what can be promised: lower the price and the promise together.
Sister stores signing as a group: a per-group rate.
notes: Numbers to test in pilot conversations, not a price list. The sales sheet and positioning quote this file; test/marketing.test.js keeps them equal. Billing itself is Milestone 5 (PLAN.md).
